title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection Bathroom | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom towel storage with a wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass in the Carolina Collection. This straight towel bar (bath towel holder / towel rail) keeps towels organized and within reach while saving space with a wall-mounted design.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction for dependable everyday use
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean installed look
- Wall mount installation helps save floor space
- Installation hardware included
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Category: Towel Bars
- Style: Traditional (works well with transitional bathroom hardware)
- Shape: Straight bar
- Center-to-center: 18-Inch
- Bar diameter: 0.75-Inch
- Overall length: 20-Inch
- Projection: 2-Inch
- Height: 3.5-Inch; Width: 2-Inch
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Includes: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
